items.title: Ken Fisher’s Firm Seen Behind $4 Billion Contrarian Bond Trade
items.summary: Billionaire Ken Fisher’s eponymous firm appears to be betting that the longest-dated US bonds will rally, a contrarian stance that seeks to capitalize on yields close to their highest in two decades.
